_readme: cSurvey APP settings (per Windows user, per computer) that the 3N kit primes into HKCU\Software\Cepelabs\cSurvey. FILE settings (centerline colour, sign sizes...) live in tdx-mapping.json `postimport` instead. Which kind a setting is, and how to add one: stages/3N-nacrt/production/csurvey-settings.md. Value type decides the registry type: a JSON string -> REG_SZ (decimals with a dot, as cSurvey writes them), a JSON integer -> REG_DWORD. Match the type cSurvey itself writes for the key.

pens.smooting.why: Freehand pen strokes are kept exactly as drawn. With the toggle off the smoothing factor (pens.smooth) is never used, so it is not set. The toggle had been switched on unintentionally (user decision 2026-10-03). cSurvey stores it as the text "0"/"1".
